headline: President Bush created a temporary federal office to help coordinate U.S. government assistance to Iraq during its transition.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a temporary organization within the U.S. government. Based on its title, the office's job was to help organize and support U.S. assistance for Iraq's transition. No summary was provided, so details about its structure, leadership, and duration are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: They would work with or through the new temporary office when providing assistance to Iraq.
The office was meant to help deliver U.S. government assistance during Iraq's transition.
